known_risks: The capability and skill manifests are descriptive and do not grant tools.
The plugin is a validated local marketplace source, but installation, runtime admission, and a fresh task remain explicit user/runtime actions.
Live model evaluation and runtime admission have not run.
The fifty-scene visual ledger is a production plan, not a completion claim: one image is generated and inspected while forty-nine remain planned.
